# CGDB Solar Full Klems fixture

`2011-SA1.XML` is an **unchanged original data file**, retrieved 2026-11-11
from [LBNL Windows & Daylighting](https://windows.lbl.gov/sites/default/files/2011-SA1.XML).
SHA-256: `5f398e08a81fecd57f9e566fa2a16f08bb0f2ca2a22fdba04d5d949c818b3336`.
Size: 2,028,000 bytes. No optical data, labels, whitespace or line endings were changed.

Credit: Complex Glazing Database (CGDB), Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory;
Copyright (c) 2016 The Regents of the University of California, through Lawrence
Berkeley National Laboratory (subject to receipt of any required approvals from
the U.S. Department of Energy). All rights reserved. Product: Nysan Satine 5500
5%, White Pearl (WS), CGDB product 6006; manufacturer metadata is preserved.

The [CGDB license](https://windows.lbl.gov/cgdb-license) grants
[CC BY-ND 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/)
([legal code](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/4.0/legalcode.en)).
That license permits unchanged redistribution with attribution and forbids
distribution of adaptations. **This data file is not covered by the repository's
MIT code license.** LBNL does not endorse Raystrack. Retain this attribution and
the unchanged XML when redistributing this fixture.

The [CGDB v1.2 release notes](https://windows.lbl.gov/sites/default/files/CGDB-1-2-ReleaseNotes.pdf)
state that the initial dataset was measured by LBNL and list product 6006 and
`2011-SA1.XML`. This is a measurement-based processed product BSDF, not a raw
goniometer dataset or a calibrated angular-uncertainty reference. The
[official import example](https://windows.lbl.gov/using-xml-bsdf-file-define-complex-system)
links the original download. No assumption of exact reciprocity is made.

The XML includes original Solar and Visible blocks. Tests use the Solar block
(ASTM 891 direct 1.5 atmosphere source, Flat detector), Full Klems 145 x 145,
Columns ordering, finite BSDF densities in sr^-1 and four supplied side lobes.
